title: Release-1 starter design comment names removed element defaults
observed: Every created Design.tao opens with "The design: a palette, element defaults, and the bundles…", but the release-1 starter projection removes element defaults (packages/cli/tao-cli/cli-src/create/release-starter-projection.ts).
impact: The first comment in the generated design file describes something the reader cannot find.
expected: Generated comments describe the generated source.
recheck: Create a starter with a release-1 CLI and read Design.tao.
